name: Ithaka
text: Ithaca, Ithake, or Ithaka (Ancient Greek: Ἰθάκη) was a Greek city on ancient Ithaca.

depictions.name: Ithaka
depictions.text: Ithaca Ithaka is a Greek island situated off the northeastern coast of Kephallonia. Together with Kephallonia, Ithaka formed the Kephallonia Islands. In Greek mythology, the island was home to Odysseus, a legendary Greek hero and King of Ithaka who fought in the Trojan War.
